title: Roster Entry
description: Schema for a single team member record. Used to validate rows if Roster.md is split into per-person files in future. Also used as the logical schema for roster table rows.

name.description: Display name of the team member.

role.description: Their role on this project (not their company title).

github_handle.description: GitHub handle, without the @ prefix. Optional but strongly recommended.

joined.description: ISO 8601 date the person joined the project (YYYY-MM-DD).
